questions_hin.q_hi:
If the number of school going children in a town is 64000 and it is increasing annually by 10%, then what will be the number of school going children in the town at the end of 3 years?

यदि किसी कस्बे में स्कूल जाने वाले बच्चों की संख्या 64000 है और यह प्रतिवर्ष 10% बढ़ रही है, तो 3 वर्ष के अंत में कस्बे में स्कूल जाने वाले बच्चों की संख्या कितनी होगी?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Initial number of school going children = 64000

Number of school going children after 3 years = (110/100)3 * 64000

= 1331 * 64

= 85184
